import urllib.request,json,pathlib
base='https://api.github.com/repos/openai/codex'

tree=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req))
p=pathlib.Path('.local/codex-transcription-research');p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(p/'tree.json').write_text(json.dumps(tree))
(p/'commit.txt').write_text(commit)
print('commit',commit,'truncated',tree.get('truncated'))
for v in tree['tree']:
 if any(x in v['path'].lower() for x in ['transcri','dictation','audio','realtime']) and v['type']=='blob': print(v['path'])
